description: This file defines a set of React components for a sheet UI element, including trigger, close, backdrop, viewport, popup, header, footer, title, description, and panel, utilizing primitives from @base-ui/react/dialog and custom styling utilities.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component that renders a trigger button for opening the sheet, passing props to the primitive trigger.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component that renders a close button for the sheet, passing props to the primitive close element.

methods.name: SheetBackdrop
methods.description: Component that renders the backdrop overlay behind the sheet with styling and className customization.

methods.name: SheetViewport
methods.description: Component that renders the viewport container for the sheet, with positioning based on side and variant.

methods.name: SheetPopup
methods.description: Component that composes the sheet popup, including portal, backdrop, viewport, and close button.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: Component for the sheet header section.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: Component for the sheet footer section, with variant styling.

methods.name: SheetPanel
methods.description: Component for the sheet content panel, wrapped in a scroll area.
